series.title: Antora Energy announces 5.8GWh ‘multi-day’ thermal energy storage project in Kansas, US

series.title: Atmos Renewables closes financing on 1.6GWh Capacity Investment Scheme-backed battery storage system in Australia
series.summary: Atmos Renewables has reached financial close on the 400MW/1,600MWh Teebar battery energy storage system (BESS) in Queensland, Australia.

series.title: EDF Power Solutions Australia refers 800MWh wind-plus-storage site to EPBC Act

series.title: Global BESS failure rates declined 98% between 2018 and 2025
series.summary: Annual battery energy storage system (BESS) failures per-deployed-GWh declined 98% globally between 2018 and 2025, as installed BESS capacity grew exponentially.

series.title: Return puts Netherlands’ largest BESS online
series.summary: BESS owner-operator Return has put its 100MW/200MWh Antares BESS in the Netherlands into commercial operation, the largest to have reached that stage in the country as far as we know.

series.title: DC’s green energy mandate burdens those who can afford it least
series.summary: The District of Columbia should review its renewable portfolio standard requirements, with solar credits adding about $20 to monthly electric bills, writes Joy Ditto, former American Public Power Association CEO.

series.title: 4-hour storage cheaper than gas peakers across global markets: WoodMac
series.summary: In North America, data centers are boosting the long-term investment case for energy storage and renewables as gas turbine backlogs and rising fuel volatility drive up peaking costs, according to a Thursday note from Wood Mackenzie.

series.title: Power system plans to meet large-load demand miss near-term solutions: analysts
series.summary: Major work by regional planners is focused on flexible access to existing transmission. Some say greater emphasis on advanced transmission technologies can quickly and cost-effectively create room for new large loads.

series.title: Massachusetts shifts clean energy funds to help heat homes this winter
series.summary: Gov. Maura Healey ordered home energy relief for low- and middle-income households, to be funded by alternative compliance payments — the fees electricity suppliers pay when they fall short of mandated clean energy targets.

series.title: Mint Renewables wins planning approval for 800MWh battery storage system in Western Australia

series.title: IEA: Thermal energy storage key to industrial heat electrification that could cut EU gas demand by 35 bcm annually
series.summary: Electrifying low-temperature industrial heat and steam processes with renewables could reduce European Union natural gas consumption by 35 billion cubic metres-per-year, according to a report from the International Energy Agency (IEA).
